description: Defines the Thunder::Core::PrivilegedRequest class, including nested Descriptor and Connection classes, for managing privileged IPC requests via domain sockets, with methods for opening, requesting, offering, and handling socket communication.

classes.name: PrivilegedRequest
classes.description: Main class managing privileged IPC requests, with nested Descriptor and Connection classes for socket descriptor management and socket communication.

classes.name: Descriptor
classes.description: Manages a file descriptor with copy/move semantics, ensuring proper resource cleanup.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Handles domain socket connection, request/offer communication, and socket event handling.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a privileged request channel with the given identifier.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Performs a request for descriptors over the privileged channel.

methods.name: Offer
methods.description: Offers descriptors over the privileged channel.
